column1: # The canonical text of every licence Cadpole's dependencies are offered
# under, and of every term allowed.txt permits.
# MIT, BSD-2/3-Clause and ISC each require "this permission notice" to
# be included with a binary distribution, and Apache-2.0 section 4(a) a
# copy of the licence itself. A list of SPDX identifiers is not that, so
# THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md reproduces these texts in full; the per-package
# copyright notices that go with them are in crates.tsv / npm.tsv.
# Source: SPDX license-list-data, tag v3.27.0, text/<id>.txt.
# `sha256` is of the file as fetched, so a text cannot drift unnoticed.
#              (every term in use has a text, and every text matches)
